_comment: Release cooldown data (docs/cooldown.md). cooldownExempt: standing exemptions, hand-maintained; npm renders ~/.npmrc min-release-age-exclude and the pnpm global config, uv is the packages I maintain, exempted per uv tool (converge uv-tools) and per repo, never in the user-level uv.toml (uv merges that into every project's uv.lock). cooldownAllow: exact npm/uv releases explicitly let past the 7-day cooldown, written by `cooldown-allow` (dot_local/bin/executable_cooldown-allow); do not hand-edit. An entry acts only until `until` (published + 7 days); after that the release passes the cooldown anyway and the package's updates follow it again.
